component.name: BlitzLLVM
component.summary: BlitzBasic, Blitz3D and BlitzPlus compiler built on LLVM

description.p: BlitzLLVM compiles BlitzBasic, Blitz3D and BlitzPlus programs to native executables with LLVM, using Vulkan and SDL3.
The Flatpak holds the compiler (blitzcc), the formatter and the runtime with the shared libraries of the programs, and its own clang and lld, from the LLVM extension of the freedesktop SDK.
It is a command-line tool and has no entry in the application menu: run it with "flatpak run com.xaymar.BlitzLLVM game.bb".
